name: find-config-bug
description: Find a subtle configuration bug in a large codebase

promptLevels.beginner: find the configuration bug where a timeout is set incorrectly
promptLevels.intermediate: locate the bug in UserService where the timeout value is in the wrong units (milliseconds vs seconds)
promptLevels.advanced:
Find the configuration bug in the codebase below where a timeout value is incorrectly set, causing API calls to fail prematurely. The bug is on line 47 of user-service.ts:

Find the configuration bug in the following codebase

languageInstructions.typescript: Provide detailed analysis with the bug location highlighted (services/user-service.ts line 47). Suggest TypeScript solutions like branded types for time values (Milliseconds vs Seconds types), centralized config with validation, const assertions, and configuration schemas with runtime checking.
languageInstructions.javascript: Provide analysis identifying the bug location and value. Suggest JavaScript prevention strategies like configuration validation functions, centralized constants files, JSDoc comments documenting units, and helper functions like `seconds(30)` that convert to milliseconds.
languageInstructions.javascript-jsdoc: Provide analysis with JSDoc-based solutions like @typedef with explicit unit documentation (e.g., @property {number} timeout - Timeout in milliseconds), validation helper functions with proper JSDoc, configuration object schemas, and unit conversion utilities.

performanceBenchmarks.name: scan-for-patterns
performanceBenchmarks.code: const code = "const timeout = 300;\nconst delay = 30000;\nconst interval = 1000;".repeat(100); for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) { const matches = code.match(/timeout\s*[=:]\s*(\d+)/g); }

performanceBenchmarks.name: validate-config-values
performanceBenchmarks.code: const configs = Array.from({length: 1000}, (_, i) => ({timeout: i * 100, retries: i % 10})); configs.forEach(cfg => { const valid = cfg.timeout > 0 && cfg.timeout < 60000 && cfg.retries > 0; });
